definitions.explanation: The large, furry forest spirit in Studio Ghibli's 1988 animated film となりのトトロ (My Neighbor Totoro), directed by Hayao Miyazaki. One of the best-known characters in Japan and the studio's emblem.

examples.japanese: トトロ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大好|だいす}き→大好き：02911_daisuki⟧だ。
「となり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧トトロ」⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{宮崎駿|みやざきはやお}⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧だ。
examples.english: My Neighbor Totoro is a film by director Hayao Miyazaki.
When I see a big tree in the woods, I feel Totoro might live there.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
The film, set in the Japanese countryside of the 1950s, has been broadcast on television again and again and is known to nearly everyone. Its Catbus (ネコバス) and the small Totoros are almost as famous, and トトロ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧ has become a name for patches of woodland preserved near Tokyo.
